rows.local_file_handling: The browser stages and validates the selected package before it becomes a local working copy. No source is uploaded merely by opening it.
rows.constraints: Use ds dsgrid inspect and ds dsgrid validate for map-independent local preflight. A project version is created only through the existing versioned-model authority.

rows.local_file_handling: Browser import stages a selected backup or workspace and runs the same inspect, digest-pinned plan, then execute sequence. CLI reads an explicit local file or directory only.
rows.constraints: Classification identifies the container, recovered PLS version and units. Unsupported, ambiguous or unsafe sources stop at inspect or plan before a model is opened. CLI bounds a source set to 512 MiB and 4,096 files and never overwrites output.

rows.local_file_handling: Browser downloads verified conversion artifacts; a browser workspace-folder export needs the File System Access API. CLI writes only into a new explicit output directory and includes exchange-report.json.
rows.constraints: Availability remains source-specific: inspect exposes only ready or unverified capabilities by default and reports blocked reasons on request. A plan pins every source digest; execution refuses changed bytes and existing output paths.

rows.local_file_handling: ds data inspect then ds data convert reads a named local source and writes a named GeoParquet artifact. Desktop large-delimited import reads from the native path in bounded chunks while producing or reusing its GeoParquet analytical artifact.
rows.constraints: The web browser can import supported data as a layer, but it does not offer a browser-local GeoParquet file writer. Tables require explicit coordinate columns unless attributes-only is selected; multi-layer sources require --layer. Existing output is refused unless --overwrite is explicit.
